sop_modules.name: Setup & Protection
sop_modules.notes: Room-level setup, floor protection, wall masking, hardware removal, and door removal. Door removal before any prep to allow flat painting workflow. Hardware removal before any coating.

tasks.name: Install localized floor protection around spray work area and sawhorse zone
tasks.notes: Canvas drop cloths at built-in base and sawhorse door-painting area. Discrete element protection — NOT full room. Includes sawhorses work area for flat door/drawer painting.

tasks.name: Install perimeter floor protection at built-in base
tasks.notes: Drop cloth runners at built-in base. Brush drip and sanding dust protection.

tasks.name: Mask wall surfaces adjacent to built-in
tasks.notes: Paper/film + tape masking at built-in-to-wall junctions (sides and top). Protects finished wall surfaces from spray overspray. Spray only.

tasks.name: Mask ceiling fixtures near spray work area
tasks.notes: Tape and plastic bag over ceiling fixtures near built-in spray work area. Only needed when spraying near ceiling-mounted fixtures.

tasks.name: Remove all hardware from built-in unit
tasks.notes: Remove hinges, knobs, pulls, catches, shelf pins. Bag and tag by opening number for reinstallation. Label hinge locations to ensure exact alignment on reinstall. Must complete before any coating work.

tasks.name: Remove doors and drawer fronts for flat painting
tasks.notes: Remove solid doors and drawer fronts from built-in. Set up on sawhorses for flat painting. Glass doors excluded (not painted). Label each door/drawer for reinstallation position. Gravity-assisted leveling on flat surfaces per FFD SS10.3.

sop_modules.name: Surface Preparation
sop_modules.notes: Opening tasks (EA_OPENING) cover all 4 tiers — rates vary by tier in production.json. Door tasks (EA) for removed door/drawer fronts. MDF edge seal conditional on SS_BARE. Caulk after fill, before primer.

tasks.name: Dust and clean all built-in surfaces
tasks.notes: Remove construction dust and debris from all opening interiors, face frames, and removed doors. Tack cloth or damp wipe. Clean inside compartments including back panels and shelf undersides. First prep step.

tasks.name: Sand interior compartment surfaces by opening tier
tasks.notes: Sand all interior surfaces per opening (sides, top, bottom, back, shelves). SS_BARE: 150-220 grit depending on substrate. SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: scuff sand 180 grit. Rigid block on flat shelf faces. Flexible sponge for inside corners and dado joints. Deep openings require reaching into compartments.

tasks.name: Sand door/drawer front surfaces
tasks.notes: Sand face and edges of removed doors/drawers on sawhorses. Flat orientation for easy access. Rigid block on flat faces. Edge sanding for detail profiles.

tasks.name: Fill fastener holes and defects in openings

quality_notes.QT4: Fill all visible holes, sand flush 220 grit.
quality_notes.QT5: Fill every hole regardless of size. Sand flush 220+ grit. Check with angled light.

tasks.notes: Built-ins have high fastener density — shelves, dividers, back panels, face frames all nailed/screwed. NC overfill-sand-flush method with HIGH waste factor (3-5x standard per Millwork Doctrine). Spackle for shallow holes, wood filler for deeper defects.

tasks.name: Fill fastener holes and defects on doors/drawers

quality_notes.QT5: Fill every hole. Perfect flush. Angled light check.

tasks.notes: Fill hinge screw holes, pull/knob fastener holes. Doors painted flat — easier fill/sand access than in-situ carcass.

tasks.name: Caulk built-in-to-wall junctions and interior joints
tasks.notes: Paintable acrylic latex caulk at: (1) built-in-to-wall perimeter on all contact edges, (2) visible shelf-to-side panel joints, (3) face frame-to-carcass joints where gaps show. Higher caulk consumption than closet shelving due to visible finish quality requirements. Caulk AFTER fill, BEFORE primer.

tasks.name: Seal MDF cut/routed edges (solvent-based)
tasks.notes: MANDATORY step 1 of MDF two-step prime. Shellac/oil-based sealer on ALL cut/routed edges inside openings and on door/drawer edges. Shelf dado joints, face frame rabbets, divider joints, back panel rabbets, door edges. Must complete BEFORE any latex primer. NON-NEGOTIABLE. Built-in MDF has very high edge density.

sop_modules.name: Primer Application
sop_modules.notes: CONDITIONAL — only runs when substrate_state = SS_BARE. Factory-primed substrates skip this module. Primer type driven by substrate chemistry (MDF=two-step already started with edge seal, FJP=stain-block, softwood=acrylic, hardwood=tannin-block). Opening and door priming are separate tasks for rate accuracy.

tasks.name: Prime interior compartment surfaces by opening tier
tasks.notes: Full primer coat on all interior opening surfaces (sides, top, bottom, back, shelves, face frame). Spray: reaches all surfaces uniformly — best for deep compartments. Brush: work shelf-by-shelf, check inside corners. MDF: step 2 latex face prime (edges already sealed). FJP: stain-block primer mandatory. Depth modifier affects production time — deep compartments slower.

tasks.name: Prime door/drawer fronts flat on sawhorses
tasks.notes: Full primer coat on face and edges of doors/drawers. Flat orientation on sawhorses — gravity-assisted leveling. Same substrate-driven primer as carcass. Prime both face and edges.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat Application
sop_modules.notes: Per-item, per-method finish tasks. Material system QT-driven. Apply, tip once, walk away (FFD SS15.3.1). Openings: EA_OPENING with tier-based rates. Doors: EA painted flat on sawhorses.

tasks.name: Spray finish coat on opening interiors
tasks.notes: Spray reaches all interior surfaces uniformly — critical for deep compartments where brush access is difficult. Light coats to prevent buildup and runs on vertical interior surfaces. Check shelf undersides and back panel for drips. Overspray inside enclosed compartments requires careful technique. Wall masking must be in place.

tasks.name: Brush finish coat on opening interiors
tasks.notes: Work shelf-by-shelf inside each opening. Mini foam roller for flat shelf faces, angled sash brush for edges and corners. Apply, tip once, walk away (FFD SS15.3.1). 2-minute window for waterborne products. Check vertical surfaces for runs. Good lighting inside compartments essential.

tasks.name: Spray finish coat on door/drawer fronts
tasks.notes: Doors laid flat on sawhorses — gravity-assisted leveling. Spray face, then rotate for edges. Light even coats. Profile detail (raised panel, beaded edge) may need angle passes.

tasks.name: Brush finish coat on door/drawer fronts
tasks.notes: Doors flat on sawhorses. Roll and Tip method (FFD SS15.6) on flat faces — mini roller to apply, brush to tip. Edges with angled sash brush. Apply, tip once, walk away. Flat orientation eliminates sag risk.

sop_modules.name: Between-Coat Interstage
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER each coat EXCEPT the final coat
sop_modules.notes: Universal at ALL quality tiers. Sanding discipline varies by QT. Opening tasks (EA_OPENING) for carcass, door tasks (EA) for removed doors. Shared FIXED tasks for cycle-level work.

tasks.name: Clean work area between coats
tasks.notes: Remove dust and debris from floor protection and sawhorse area. Built-in compartments trap sanding dust — clear out dust from inside openings.

tasks.name: Inspect previous coat on all surfaces

quality_notes.QT4: Systematic 3-foot inspection. Mark all defects. Light inside compartments.
quality_notes.QT5: Lighted critical inspection at arm's length. Zero tolerance. Angled light on every shelf face and door front.

tasks.notes: Inspect openings and doors in one pass. Key checkpoints: shelf face brush marks, inside corner runs, back panel coverage, door front leveling, face frame detail coverage. Use flashlight inside deep compartments.

tasks.name: Sand between coats on opening interiors
tasks.notes: Sand all interior opening surfaces. Rigid block on flat shelf faces (FFD SS15.4.1). Flexible sponge for inside corners and dado joints. Deep compartments require reaching in — good lighting essential to verify uniform scratch pattern.

tasks.name: Sand between coats on door/drawer fronts
tasks.notes: Doors flat on sawhorses — easy access for thorough sanding. Rigid block on flat faces. Profile edges with flexible sanding approach.

tasks.name: Patch and repair marked defects
tasks.notes: Fill, sand, and spot-prime any defects found during inspection. Scope varies by QT.

tasks.name: Spot coat patched areas
tasks.notes: Touch-up patched areas to match surrounding finish before next full coat.

tasks.name: Tack cloth all surfaces before next coat
tasks.notes: Remove all sanding dust with tack cloth before next coat. Cover every surface — shelves, sides, backs, door fronts. Work into inside corners and dado joints. Built-in compartments trap dust that settles on horizontal shelves.

tasks.name: Final quality inspection of all built-in surfaces

quality_notes.QT3: Normal viewing distance scan. 39" inspection distance.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic 3-foot review with raking light. Light inside all compartments.
quality_notes.QT5: Critical arm's-length inspection. Angled light on all surfaces. Zero tolerance.

tasks.notes: Inspect all openings and door fronts. Key checkpoints: shelf face sheen uniformity, inside corner coverage, caulk line quality, fill quality, door front leveling, edge coverage. Use flashlight inside deep compartments. Verify no drips on back panels.

tasks.name: Touch-up defects found during final inspection
tasks.notes: Correct remaining defects. Feather touch-ups into surrounding finish. QT5: may require full additional coat if defects are widespread.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup & Reinstallation
sop_modules.notes: Door/drawer reinstallation, hardware reinstallation, protection removal, and cleanup. Door reinstall after 5-7 day cure for waterborne alkyd (QT4+). Hardware reinstall after doors are hung.

tasks.name: Reinstall doors and drawer fronts
tasks.notes: CONSTRAINT: Minimum 5-7 day cure for waterborne alkyd (QT4+) before closing doors. Premature closing causes finish fusion per FFD SS15.11.3. Align hinges to original marked locations. Check door operation — swing clearance may change with paint film thickness on hinge mortises. Prop doors slightly open until fully cured. Drawer fronts: reinstall but leave slightly open.

tasks.name: Reinstall all hardware
tasks.notes: Reinstall hinges, knobs, pulls, catches, shelf pins from labeled bags. Clean paint from screw holes before reinstallation. Account for paint film thickness on hinge mortises. Verify door alignment and operation after hardware install.

tasks.name: Remove wall adjacent masking
tasks.notes: Score tape edge before removal. Pull at 45-degree angle. Spray only.

tasks.name: Remove fixture masking
tasks.notes: Remove tape and plastic from ceiling fixtures. Clean any adhesive residue. Spray only.

tasks.name: Remove floor protection
tasks.notes: Remove drop cloths from floor. Fold inward to contain debris. Includes sawhorse area protection.

tasks.name: Vacuum work area
tasks.notes: Vacuum floor area after protection removal. Include inside built-in compartments — sanding dust settles inside.

tasks.name: Clean tools and equipment
tasks.notes: Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment, dispose of consumables. Water cleanup for waterborne products. Solvent cleanup for shellac-based MDF edge sealer residue. Fold and store sawhorses.

workflow_sequence.standard_bare_spray: MOD_BLTN_SETUP > MOD_BLTN_PREP > MOD_BLTN_PRIME > MOD_BLTN_INTERSTAGE > MOD_BLTN_FINISH_COAT(1) > MOD_BLTN_INTERSTAGE > MOD_BLTN_FINISH_COAT(2) > MOD_BLTN_FINAL_INSPECT > MOD_BLTN_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.standard_factory_primed_spray: MOD_BLTN_SETUP > MOD_BLTN_PREP > MOD_BLTN_FINISH_COAT(1) > MOD_BLTN_INTERSTAGE > MOD_BLTN_FINISH_COAT(2) > MOD_BLTN_FINAL_INSPECT > MOD_BLTN_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.qt5_brush: MOD_BLTN_SETUP > MOD_BLTN_PREP > [MOD_BLTN_PRIME] > [MOD_BLTN_INTERSTAGE] > MOD_BLTN_FINISH_COAT(1) > MOD_BLTN_INTERSTAGE > MOD_BLTN_FINISH_COAT(2) > MOD_BLTN_INTERSTAGE > MOD_BLTN_FINISH_COAT(3) > MOD_BLTN_FINAL_INSPECT > MOD_BLTN_CLEANUP
workflow_sequence.notes: Prime module conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE. QT5 brush adds third FINISH_COAT + INTERSTAGE per FFD SS15.10.3. Two item types — openings (EA_OPENING by tier S/M/L/XL) and doors (EA). Door reinstallation in CLEANUP has 5-7 day cure constraint.

round_configurations.name: Primer + 2 finish coats
round_configurations.description: Full coat sequence for bare substrate at QT3/QT4
round_configurations.notes: 3 total coats (1 primer + 2 finish), 2 interstage cycles.

round_configurations.name: 2 finish coats (no primer)
round_configurations.description: Standard coat sequence for factory-primed substrate

round_configurations.name: 3 finish coats (QT5 brush)
round_configurations.description: Extended coat sequence for QT5 brush per FFD SS15.10.3
round_configurations.notes: 3 total finish coats, 2 interstage cycles. May include MOD_BLTN_PRIME if SS_BARE.
